# Subway Seat for gh-dash

Parchment text, orange borders on the active section and a warm selected row, with author-role icons in the palette's accents. gh-dash shows PR diffs through its pager, so set `pager: {diff: delta}` in the same config to see them with the delta port.

[gh-dash](https://github.com/dlvhdr/gh-dash) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/gh-dash/) · Needs gh-dash 4.25+ for `include`

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat.yml
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-tunnel.yml
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-enamel.yml
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/london-moquette.yml
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/london-deep-level.yml
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/gh-dash/config.yml (on releases before 4.25, paste the theme block in instead):

```yaml
include:
  - ~/.config/gh-dash/london-portland.yml
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat.yml`.
- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-tunnel.yml`.
- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/subway-seat-enamel.yml`.
- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/london-moquette.yml`.
- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/london-deep-level.yml`.
- Delete `~/.config/gh-dash/london-portland.yml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
